channel.title: Tessera Field Notes
channel.description: Aging and biomarker science, translated into what to actually do. From the team building Tessera, an open longevity engine.

item.title: The four levers that actually move your biomarkers in 90 days
item.description: Almost everything you can change runs through four levers: nutrition, training, sleep, and a short list of supplements. What the evidence supports, ranked by how much it moves the needle.

item.title: Biological age, honestly: what PhenoAge can and can't tell you
item.description: Biological-age scores are real science and routinely oversold. What PhenoAge measures, what an epigenetic clock is, and how to read your number without fooling yourself.

item.title: Your blood report uses the wrong reference ranges
item.description: Normal on a lab report is the average of everyone who walked into a lab, the unwell included. Optimal is a different number. Why your report can say fine when you're not.
